title: Swedish ghost rockets and Doolittle's investigation

tellings.quote: 1946 and 7, there were these ghost rockets showing up in Sweden. They looked like these modified V2s. you had over a thousand sightings of these. And so again, not disputed that Eisenhower sent uh General James Doolittle out to investigate that.

plain: In 1946 and 1947, according to Michels, more than a thousand sightings of "ghost rockets" were reported over Sweden, objects that looked like modified V2s, the German rockets of the Second World War. He says it is "not disputed" that Eisenhower sent General James Doolittle to investigate. Michels tells this himself, without naming a source, to show that the US military took unexplained craft seriously even before the UFO era began.
